decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-14, on the Hebrew names no number, lexeme or peoples rule could settle: each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's instruction of 2026-10-14 ('Роби як логічніше', do what is more logical); no person has reviewed these rulings
policy: A word names the people, land, man or place its verse names: a name that acts as a nation is the people, a land where a land record is held, a man where the verse makes him a father or a son, and among namesakes the one the verse identifies. Where the verse cannot tell, the word is left without a record.
